name: innovation_gated_support_consensus
support_state: binary indicator of the framewise nonnegative Top-K code
unary_score: negative standardized pre-projection FISTA amplitudes plus graph-neighbor activation evidence
solver: three alternating forward/backward Top-K sweeps followed by amplitude-only projected-gradient debiasing on the selected supports
innovation_gate: g_t=clip(exp(-0.5*(r_t/tau)^2),g_min,1), with r_t=||z_t-z_{t-1}K_est^T||_2 divided by the median nonzero code norm
koopman_transition_weight: same g_t used in ridge cross-covariance
